title: Sleeping Toddler with Toy Gun, 1950s B&W Snapshot
description: A candid mid-century black and white snapshot of a young toddler fast asleep on a carpeted living room floor. His head rests on a small pillow while he wears a toy holster belt around his waist, holding a toy pistol even in sleep. The background displays typical mid-century modern furniture legs and upholstery, capturing a charming moment of childhood play and domestic life in post-war America.
